_note: New actor, first pricing entry. JobStreet/JobsDB rivals: blackfalcondata/jobstreet-scraper (108 monthly users), shahidirfan (33), memo23 (28), JobsDB ~84 combined. Same stack and price as seek-jobs-scraper: job_row $0.003 with description, job_row_basic $0.002. No start fee, no per-run allowance. No proxy.

job_row.eventDescription: One JobStreet or JobsDB job with title, company, location, salary text and parsed range in local currency, work type, remote or hybrid, category, listing date, teaser, bullet points and full description. A run that returns no jobs is free.

job_row_basic.eventDescription: One JobStreet or JobsDB job with the same fields but no full description (Full description off, or the description could not be read).
